about: The population each US directory library serves, largest first, for ranking the US library pages (owner, 24 November 2026: the 500 largest libraries the app can check have pages; tools/seo/us-pages.mjs ranks the offered ones, and a test checks them). Written by node tools/directory/us-population.mjs from the IMLS file (source) and the directory, never by hand. fscsKey: the IMLS administrative entity whose POPU_UND is the population: the key the entry records (a shared catalog's member records its own; an outlet key, a library with no administrative entity of its own, takes its entity's, noted). keySource "match": a legacy entry (BiblioCommons and a few others, from before the US research), which records no key, takes the key the USA research's IMLS item matched it to by name and state, reviewed by hand (fscsKeys and their sum for a consortium's catalog matched to its members). population null: IMLS gives none, or the entry has no IMLS record (a school or college catalog), with the reason; it ranks last.
source: Institute of Museum and Library Services, Public Libraries Survey FY2024, administrative entity file PLS_FY24_AE_pud24i.csv (pls_fy2024_csv.zip from imls.gov, downloaded 23 November 2026), POPU_UND: the unduplicated population of the legal service area
